notes.title: Dev update - 12/08/2025
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We are pleased to announce that we have already implemented these two important features:[/p][list][*][p]Steam cloud save: you will be able to use the steam cloud save feature, so you will synchronise your save with the cloud![/p][/*][*][p]Steam achievements: are you ready to try to get all the achievements?[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]See you all in the Swamp![/p][p][/p][p]GunginStudio [/p]
